In independent percolation on a finite hypergraph, with arbitrary hyperedge probabilities in $[0,1]$, let $o$ be a node and let $A,T$ be node sets with $A\ne\varnothing$. Then $$\label{cmp:joint-bound}
 \mathbb P(o\leftrightarrow A,\ o\leftrightarrow T)

Let $G$ be a finite hypergraph whose hyperedges have independent open probabilities strictly less than one. Choose any ordered list of distinct nodes $x_1,\ldots,x_n$; the list need not contain every node. Define $$S_k=\{x_i:i<k\},\qquad
 E_k=\{C(x_k)\cap S_k=\varnothing\},\qquad
 d_k=\mathbb P(E_k)>0,$$ and let $\mu_k$ be the conditional law of $C(x_k)$ given $E_k$, regarded as a measure on $$\mathcal D_k=\{U:x_k\in U,\ U\cap S_k=\varnothing\}.$$ For a function $F$ on $\mathcal D_k$, let $$v_k^F(i)=\mathbb E_{\mu_k}
       [\mathbf 1_{\{x_i\in U\}}F(U)],\qquad
 h_k=v_k^1,\qquad H=(h_1\ \cdots\ h_n).$$ If $F$ is nonnegative and increasing under inclusion, then $$\label{cmp:cone-relation}
 v_k^F-\mu_k(F)h_k
   \in\operatorname{cone}\{h_j:k<j\le n\}.$$ Here the cone consists of all nonnegative linear combinations, including zero. In particular, $H^{-1}v_k^F$ is coordinatewise nonnegative.

Consider independent bond or site percolation on a finite undirected graph, with arbitrary individual probabilities in $[0,1]$. For a vertex $o$, vertex sets $A,T$, and $b\in[0,1]$, if $$\mathbb P(a\leftrightarrow T)\ge1-b\qquad(a\in A),$$ then $$\label{cmp:failure-bound}
 \mathbb P(o\leftrightarrow A,\ o\not\leftrightarrow T)\le b.$$ The assertion therefore applies after any deterministic collection of bits has been fixed.

There are deterministic families $\mathcal C_n$ of simple dual cycles of length $n$, with $|\mathcal C_n|\le 2n3^n$, such that the dual edge boundary of every finite $X\subset\mathbb Z^2$ containing $0$ includes a cycle in $\bigcup_{n\ge1}\mathcal C_n$. For each cycle in $\mathcal C_n$, one can fix at least $n/7$ of its crossed primal edges with pairwise disjoint endpoints.

Let $G$ be a finite subgraph of $\mathbb Z^3$ containing a rectangle $D$ and every lattice edge internal to $D$. Give its bits independent laws, with parameter $q$ on all bits internal to $D$ and arbitrary parameters, including $0$ and $1$, elsewhere. Let $o\in V(G)$ and $T\subseteq V(G)$. Suppose that a rectangle $B$ satisfies $$B^{(R)}\subseteq D,
 \qquad o\notin B^{(R)},$$ and that for every $u\in B^{(R)}$ there is a radius $\ell\in\{2r,2r+1,10r\}$ such that $\Lambda_\ell(u)\subseteq D$ and some quarter-face of this cube is contained in $T$. Then, for connections in $G$, $$\mathbb P(o\leftrightarrow B,\ o\not\leftrightarrow T)<\eta.
 \label{ext:conclusion}$$

coverage.checked_domain: 6292 deterministic queries: all probabilities in {0,1/2,1}, origins, nonempty relay sets and target sets for the two-node hypergraph with all nonempty hyperedges and for all single-hyperedge three-node hypergraphs; selected four-node, duplicate-label and unequal-probability cases.
coverage.oracle_basis: Exhaustive product-state enumeration; union-find with exact fmpq is checked independently by Boolean transitive closure and Fraction arithmetic. Every output probability and slack is re-computed exactly; no solver witnesses are used.
